description: macwin-net: QUIC transport (quinn 0.11.12 + rustls 0.23.45 with the ring provider) with mandatory mutual TLS and SHA-256 certificate-fingerprint pinning in both directions, persistent self-signed identity (rcgen) with 0600 files and MACWIN_CONFIG_DIR override, session establishment (control + high-priority input bi streams, Hello exchange with version check), transport-agnostic Link (control, input, latest-wins datagrams, graceful and immediate close, Link::memory_pair), application close codes, and 127.0.0.1 loopback tests including wrong-fingerprint rejection on both sides. Plan items 13-14 with decisions B5. Depends on FEAT-004 (proto).
steps: Plan item 13: crates/macwin-net/src/fingerprint.rs (Fingerprint([u8;32]), of_cert via ring::digest::SHA256, Display 64 lowercase hex, FromStr accepting case-insensitive hex with optional ':' separators). crates/macwin-net/src/identity.rs (Identity {cert, key}, generate() via rcgen::generate_simple_self_signed(vec!["macwin".into()]) -> CertifiedKey{cert, signing_key}, fingerprint(), load_or_create(dir) -> (Identity, created) with identity.crt.pem/identity.key.pem, unix dir 0700 + files 0600 written to temp then renamed, half-present identity -> error, PEM parsing via rustls::pki_types::pem::PemObject; config_dir(env closure) with MACWIN_CONFIG_DIR override, macOS ~/Library/Application Support/macwin, Windows %APPDATA%\macwin, other unix XDG/HOME fallback). crates/macwin-net/src/codes.rs (NORMAL 0, PROTOCOL_VIOLATION 1, VERSION_MISMATCH 2, HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT 3, HELLO_TIMEOUT 4, INTERNAL 5; code_for(&CloseReason)). NetError in lib.rs.

Plan item 13 (cont.): crates/macwin-net/src/tls.rs: ring provider via Arc::new(rustls::crypto::ring::default_provider()) passed with builder_with_provider (never installed process-wide), TLS 1.3 only, ALPN b"macwin/1"; PinnedServerVerifier (rustls::client::danger::ServerCertVerifier) and PinnedClientVerifier (rustls::server::danger::ClientCertVerifier, offer_client_auth + client_auth_mandatory true, root_hint_subjects empty) comparing SHA-256 of the end-entity cert, rejecting with CertificateError::ApplicationVerificationFailure and a WARN log of expected/actual; tls13 signature checks via rustls::crypto::verify_tls13_signature with provider.signature_verification_algorithms; tls12 returns an error. client_config/server_config build quinn configs via QuicClientConfig/QuicServerConfig::try_from, transport max_idle_timeout 10 s, keep_alive_interval 1 s, datagrams enabled. Unit tests: format/parse of fingerprints, config_dir branches via closures (no env mutation), each verifier accepts the pinned cert and rejects a different generated cert.

Plan item 14: crates/macwin-net/src/link.rs (Inbound, LinkClosed, LinkSender with send_control/send_input (try_send, overflow -> close_now(INTERNAL) + Err), send_datagram (drop when full), close (graceful: flush+finish streams bounded 500 ms, then connection close), close_now; Link {tx, rx}; Link::memory_pair()). crates/macwin-net/src/session.rs (dialer opens 2 bi streams writing header bytes 0x01 control / 0x02 input; listener accepts and assigns by header; input set_priority(1); both send Hello first and read the peer Hello within 5 s; not-a-Hello -> PROTOCOL_VIOLATION, check_version failure -> VERSION_MISMATCH + Err(Proto(IncompatibleVersion)), timeout -> HELLO_TIMEOUT; spawn writer/reader/datagram tasks; decode error on any channel -> close_now(PROTOCOL_VIOLATION) + Inbound::Closed(ProtocolViolation); exactly one Inbound::Closed per connection mapped from quinn::ConnectionError). crates/macwin-net/src/endpoint.rs (listen(bind, id, peer_fp) -> Listener {local_addr, accept(&Hello) -> Result<Session>}; connect(bind, remote, id, peer_fp, &Hello) -> Result<Session>, SNI "macwin"; Session {peer, link, remote} keeps the Endpoint alive).

Plan item 14 tests: crates/macwin-net/tests/loopback.rs cases 1-8 from plan B5, all bound to 127.0.0.1:0, every await under tokio::time::timeout(5 s), #[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread")]: correct pins + Hello + all three channels both directions; client pins wrong server fp (connect Err AND accept Err); server pins wrong client fp (accept Err AND connect Err — the client may complete TLS 1.3 first and fail during stream setup/Hello); version-major mismatch on both sides; graceful close delivers 100 ordered input msgs then PeerClosed{0}; close_now(INTERNAL) -> PeerClosed{5}; memory_pair round trip; identity persistence/permissions/half-present error with tempfile dirs.
acceptance_criteria: `RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable cargo test -p macwin-net` passes three consecutive runs
A connection is rejected on BOTH sides when either side pins the wrong fingerprint; there is no API path that builds a TLS config without the pinned verifiers
Peers with different protocol major versions both fail with ProtoError::IncompatibleVersion
Identity files are 0600 and the directory 0700 on unix; reloading yields the same fingerprint
All test sockets bind 127.0.0.1; aws-lc-rs absent from the graph; #![forbid(unsafe_code)] kept; clippy -D warnings clean on host and x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
